_about: Settings for the data checks. Values marked PLACEHOLDER must be agreed with the customer.

stale_after_days.note: PLACEHOLDER: agree the staleness window with the customer

scan_recent_days.note: PLACEHOLDER: how recently an asset must have been scanned to count as covered

coverage.note: Coverage is measured over machines seen by the vulnerability scanner or the EDR tool. Devices seen only by the identity tool are listed separately and not counted, until the customer agrees which devices are in scope.

readiness.text: Export counts differ from what the customer's console shows
readiness.ok_text: Export counts match what the customer's console shows

readiness.text: Possible duplicates are waiting for a person to decide
readiness.ok_text: No possible duplicates are waiting for a person

readiness.text: Findings point to assets no tool reports
readiness.ok_text: Every finding points to an asset a tool reports

readiness.text: Stale assets need a decision: keep, exclude, or investigate
Endpoint agent coverage is below the agreed threshold (PLACEHOLDER: 90%)
readiness.ok_text: Endpoint agent coverage meets the agreed threshold (PLACEHOLDER: 90%)
